description: Check whether quoted words are really in the Bible, word for word, against the stored King James Version (the whole Bible) and the World English Bible passages cached here, and return the real wording when they are not. Use before presenting any remembered or user supplied wording as a quotation of Scripture ("is this a real Bible verse", "where is this verse from", "did the Bible say this"). Not for reading a known reference (scripture_passage), finding verses by a word (scripture_search), or reading a verse in another of the stored translations (compare_translations); quotations from other translations are not matched, so a faithful quotation of a translation not checked here shows as differing, which is not proof it is wrong. quote is the exact words as they would be quoted; reference, optional, is where they are attributed and is checked too. Returns verdict (verbatim, close_but_differs, resembles, not_found) with a verdict_sentence, best_match (reference, translation, stored text, SHA-256 per verse and for the whole match, word diff), alternatives, claimed_check, differences, not_found, and corpora_checked. Matching folds case, accents and punctuation; deterministic, no network; an unreadable stored text returns an error to retry. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

quote.description: The exact words to check, as they would be quoted.

reference.description: Optional: the reference the words are attributed to, e.g. "John 3:16" or "Philippians 4:13".

name: verify_scripture_quote

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

best_match.description: The closest held text: reference, translation, verbatim stored words, SHA-256 of the whole match, each verse with its own hash, and the word diff against the quote; null when not_found.

claimed_check.description: When reference was given and read: whether that reference holds the words; null otherwise.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

corpora_checked.description: The stored texts compared against, with license and coverage.

differences.description: Readable list of the words that differ from the held text.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

not_found.description: Sentence naming the texts checked, present only when not_found.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: Web page where the best match can be read in context.

verdict.description: verbatim: every word held in order; close_but_differs: 80 percent of words or more; resembles: 50 percent and at least four words; not_found: nothing held is close.

verdict_sentence.description: One plain sentence stating the verdict and what to quote instead.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Verify a Scripture quotation
